liner.body_md:
## What listeners single out

- **Samson and Delilah** (1 review): The opener rocked and convinced the reviewer the night would be special [7]
- **Jack Straw** (1 review): Reviewer found it somewhat sluggish and wanted a faster tempo [5]
- **Scarlet Begonias** (1 review): Scarlet into Fire was a highlight, described as electric [6]
- **All Along The Watchtower** (1 review): Named as a highlight and described as electric [6]

## The recordings

- **deadco2024-05-26.Chas** (recommended): source not stated; 19 songs; 167 min; rated 4/5 by 1 [1]. Said about its sound: Reviewer calls it the best-sounding Sphere recording so far [8]
- **deadco2024-05-26.Rainbowtoez.Shell**: source not stated; 19 songs; 167 min; rated 3/5 by 3 [2]. Said about its sound: Reviewer wished the audience recording sounded better, rating the tape 4 out of 10 [6]
- **deadco2024-05-26**: audience recording; 18 songs; 166 min; rated 4.5/5 by 2 [3]. Said about its sound: Bobby's vocals sit too low for much of the show, reflecting the mix in that section; Reviewer calls it the best Sphere recording so far [3][9]

## Around the show

- Stage talk about: Crowd / 1st Set, Crowd/ 2nd set [1]
- The taper was the only one in the official taper section, Sec 103, Row 36 [3]
- Reviewer stood in the pit about three rows back, in front of John Mayer [7]
- They lined up at 5 pm, beside a couple from LA and a minister and son from Germany [7]
- Reviewer rates the music quality above the 5-25-24 show, but finds the visuals less appealing [5]

## Tapers and lineage

- **deadco2024-05-26.Chas**: taped by 21rooms1willdo; transferred by Hunter S; source: Zoom H5 Handheld on ledge [1]. Also: Transfer chain ran from WAV through Reaper to 24-bit FLAC [1]
- **deadco2024-05-26.Rainbowtoez.Shell**: taped by Rainbowtoez; transferred by Hunter S; source: Apogee ClipMic digital 2 > iPhone [2]
- **deadco2024-05-26**: taped by Antonio Aversano; transferred by Antonio Aversano; source: Audience [3]. Also: Without mic stands, the taper put a Zoom H4N on a chair beside the video camera operator [3]

## Art and photos

- Poster by Worthpoint: [OFFICIAL DEAD & CO. Tour Poster THE SPHERE 05/26/2024 N/1135 | #4731717238](https://www.worthpoint.com/worthopedia/official-dead-co-tour-poster-sphere-4731717238) [11]
